title: SIMPLE SYNTHETIC DATA REDUCES SYCOPHANCY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on 'sycophancy' in LLMs and a synthetic data intervention to reduce it. While it includes evaluations on benchmarks that contain ethics and philosophy sub-tasks (such as MMLU 'Moral Disputes' or philosophy survey questions), these are used to measure general sycophantic tendencies or performance retention rather than as a primary evaluation of religious or ethical systems themselves.
